videos.topic: DeepSeek is a victim of its own popularity: rising demand for its newest model means it is raising prices.
videos.redo: Miguel approved the split and the whiteboard. Build the cutout only. Your approved outline is in matting/deepseekprices/selection.json. My manual track after the Codex limit was REFUSED by the chair audit (prep/stages/deepseekprices.track.json: a dark area by the right shoulder with luma ~50, which the audit reads as body, not chair): look at the overlay, decide whether it is his shoulder or chair, fix the outline if needed, re-approve, and track. If you conclude it is body, delete matting/deepseekprices/chair_audit.json only after you have looked, then track.
